market_summary: All five assets are currently trading in low-volatility compression regimes during the London session ahead of the New York open. Price across metals, FX pairs, and BTC is universally trading below descending session VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, yet hovering inside Value Areas or stalling directly on local structural support without institutional volume confirmation (RVOL < 1.4 across the board, with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 spikes). Because the market is displaying chop and mean-reversion characteristics near fair-value magnets rather than trend expansion, disciplined capital preservation dictates a HOLD across all instruments until the NY session provides clear breakout volume or sweeps.
